original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A broad grey-stone Embercourt frontier fortress with red roofs, gold flame banners, a beacon tower, and an irregular grass-and-dirt settlement edge.
A compact red-roofed stone lock fort spans an ember canal beneath copper beacons.
An ivory observatory gathers around a broad gold-rimmed dawn mirror and twin blue prism towers.
A vast circular root wheel holds mossy homes, amber seed lanterns, and antlered branch towers.
A black-brick foundry fortress wraps furnaces and gantries around one immense glowing copper coil.
A moonlit ghost-dock rises through colossal ship ribs beneath teal sails and a silver mourning bell.
A sandstone lock fortress spans three bronze floodgates beneath blue roofs and amber beacon fires.
Tiered reedstone huts and bridges climb toward a tall oval oath shrine among green and violet bog lamps.
White terraces and gold prism vanes gather around a tall blue faceted resonance spire.
A vast living crownroot shelters orchard homes, woven bridges, and an amber-lit healing hollow.
A black basalt foundry suspends an immense bronze bell above orange furnaces and blue quench channels.
Ivory rib piers surround black-sailed slips and a tall aquamarine echo beacon.
A rain-fed river fortress where civic ledgers, sluice power, and protected grain rotations turn recovery into sustained road pressure.
A crescent shrine-town where moon pools, votive jars, and reed tolls turn battlefield tribute into spell and pressure tempo.
A divided prism observatory whose mirrored courts train timing, focus, and exact response along exposed desert lanes.
A living hollow settlement where root-hearths and graft gardens return wounded companies to the road without severing the old canopy.
A white-ceramic pressure yard where brass gauges, datum rails, and controlled furnace trials turn machine companies into exact field instruments.
A fogbound bell harbor whose tide pools and memory chimes reveal hidden sea lanes before hostile sails enter the inner wake.

town_default_sprite.fit: Fail-closed fallback for missing, unmapped, or unloadable town faction identity; owner state remains indicated by the existing compact renderer pennant.
